brief:
Israeli occupation authorities are intensifying military and settlement presence along the border with Jordan through the establishment of security barriers, mine clearance operations, and expanded military deployment, Shehab Wire reported. The measures coincide with efforts to establish approximately 40 settlement outposts in the region.

The fortification campaign represents a broader strategy to consolidate Israeli control along its eastern frontier, combining infrastructure development with security infrastructure upgrades across the Jordan Valley area.
